# Table VIII - IV Replication


## Load the data

```{r load-data}
library(haven)
library(ivreg)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

country_data <- read_dta("crosscountry_dataset.dta")

instruments <- c("plow_positive_crops", "plow_negative_crops")

controls <- c(
  "agricultural_suitability", "tropical_climate", "large_animals",
  "political_hierarchies", "economic_complexity", "ln_income",
  "ln_income_squared", "continent"
)

model_variables <- c("flfp2000", "plow", instruments, controls)
iv_data <- country_data[, model_variables]
iv_data <- iv_data[complete.cases(iv_data), ]
iv_data$continent <- factor(iv_data$continent)

nrow(iv_data)
```

## Panel A - First-stage results

```{r first-stage}
first_stage_formula <- reformulate(
  c(instruments, controls),
  response = "plow"
)

first_stage <- lm(first_stage_formula, data = iv_data)
first_stage_vcov <- vcovHC(first_stage, type = "HC1")

first_stage_results <- coeftest(first_stage, vcov. = first_stage_vcov)
first_stage_results[instruments, , drop = FALSE]

instrument_estimates <- coef(first_stage)[instruments]
instrument_vcov <- first_stage_vcov[instruments, instruments]

first_stage_f <- drop(
  crossprod(instrument_estimates, solve(instrument_vcov, instrument_estimates))
) / length(instruments)

round(first_stage_f, 2)
```

### First-stage test of equality

```{r first-stage-equality}
contrast <- c(1, -1)
coefficient_difference <- sum(contrast * instrument_estimates)
difference_variance <- drop(crossprod(
  contrast, instrument_vcov %*% contrast
))

equality_f <- coefficient_difference^2 / difference_variance
equality_p <- pf(
  equality_f, df1 = 1, df2 = df.residual(first_stage),
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

c(F_statistic = equality_f, p_value = equality_p)
```

## Panel B - Reduced-form results

```{r reduced-form}
reduced_form_formula <- reformulate(
  c(instruments, controls),
  response = "flfp2000"
)

reduced_form <- lm(reduced_form_formula, data = iv_data)
reduced_form_vcov <- vcovHC(reduced_form, type = "HC1")
reduced_form_results <- coeftest(reduced_form, vcov. = reduced_form_vcov)

reduced_form_results[instruments, , drop = FALSE]
```


## Panel C - IV results

```{r iv-results}
iv_formula <- as.formula(paste(
  "flfp2000 ~", paste(c("plow", controls), collapse = " + "),
  "|", paste(c(instruments, controls), collapse = " + ")
))

iv_model <- ivreg(iv_formula, data = iv_data)
iv_vcov <- vcovHC(iv_model, type = "HC0")
iv_results <- coeftest(iv_model, vcov. = iv_vcov)

iv_results["plow", , drop = FALSE]
nobs(iv_model)
```

### Robust Hausman endogeneity test

```{r hausman-test}
iv_data$first_stage_residual <- residuals(first_stage)

hausman_formula <- reformulate(
  c("plow", "first_stage_residual", controls),
  response = "flfp2000"
)

hausman_model <- lm(hausman_formula, data = iv_data)
hausman_vcov <- vcovHC(hausman_model, type = "HC1")
hausman_results <- coeftest(hausman_model, vcov. = hausman_vcov)

hausman_results["first_stage_residual", , drop = FALSE]
```

### Hansen J test

```{r hansen-j-test}
regressor_matrix <- model.matrix(
  reformulate(c("plow", controls)), data = iv_data
)
instrument_matrix <- model.matrix(
  reformulate(c(instruments, controls)), data = iv_data
)

outcome_values <- iv_data$flfp2000
iv_residuals <- residuals(iv_model)

moment_covariance <- crossprod(instrument_matrix * iv_residuals)
instrument_regressor_products <- crossprod(instrument_matrix, regressor_matrix)
instrument_outcome_products <- crossprod(instrument_matrix, outcome_values)

weighted_regressor_products <- solve(
  moment_covariance, instrument_regressor_products
)
weighted_outcome_products <- solve(
  moment_covariance, instrument_outcome_products
)

gmm_coefficients <- solve(
  crossprod(instrument_regressor_products, weighted_regressor_products),
  crossprod(instrument_regressor_products, weighted_outcome_products)
)

gmm_residuals <- outcome_values - drop(regressor_matrix %*% gmm_coefficients)
sample_moments <- crossprod(instrument_matrix, gmm_residuals)

hansen_j <- drop(crossprod(
  sample_moments, solve(moment_covariance, sample_moments)
))
hansen_df <- ncol(instrument_matrix) - ncol(regressor_matrix)
hansen_p <- pchisq(hansen_j, df = hansen_df, lower.tail = FALSE)

c(J_statistic = hansen_j, degrees_of_freedom = hansen_df, p_value = hansen_p)
```

```{r ols-same-sample}
ols_model <- lm(ols_formula, data = iv_data)

ols_results["plow", , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r iv-table-export}
iv_rows <- rbind(
  first_stage_results[instruments, , drop = FALSE],
  reduced_form_results[instruments, , drop = FALSE],
```

# Tables III and IV - OLS Replication

## Setup

```{r ols-setup, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Output folders: knitting creates "tables" and "figures" in the same folder as
# this .Rmd file and saves the table (.tex) and figures (.png, .pdf) there.
# They are recreated (overwritten) every time the file is knitted.
# Note: crosscountry_dataset.dta must be in the same folder as this .Rmd file.
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

historical_controls <- c(
  "agricultural_suitability", "tropical_climate", "large_animals",
  "political_hierarchies", "economic_complexity"
)

contemporary_controls <- c("ln_income", "ln_income_squared")
```

## OLS estimation

```{r ols-function}
fit_ols <- function(controls_used, continent_fe) {
  regressors <- c("plow", controls_used)
  if (continent_fe) regressors <- c(regressors, "continent")

  sample_variables <- c("flfp2000", "plow", controls_used)
  ols_data <- country_data[, c(sample_variables, "continent", "isocode")]
  ols_data <- ols_data[complete.cases(ols_data[, sample_variables]), ]
  ols_data$continent <- factor(ols_data$continent)

  ols_fit <- lm(reformulate(regressors, response = "flfp2000"), data = ols_data)
  ols_fit_vcov <- vcovHC(ols_fit, type = "HC1")

  list(
    model    = ols_fit,
    vcov     = ols_fit_vcov,
    results  = coeftest(ols_fit, vcov. = ols_fit_vcov),
    data     = ols_data,
    controls = controls_used,
    fe       = continent_fe
  )
}
```

```{r ols-estimation}
ols_models <- list(
  "III (1)" = fit_ols(historical_controls, continent_fe = FALSE),
  "III (2)" = fit_ols(historical_controls, continent_fe = TRUE),
  "IV (1)"  = fit_ols(c(historical_controls, contemporary_controls), continent_fe = FALSE),
  "IV (2)"  = fit_ols(c(historical_controls, contemporary_controls), continent_fe = TRUE)
)

ols_models[["IV (2)"]]$results["plow", , drop = FALSE]
nobs(ols_models[["IV (2)"]]$model)
```

## Table: Replication

```{r ols-table-function}
coefficient_labels <- c(
  plow                     = "Traditional plough use",
  agricultural_suitability = "Agricultural suitability",
  tropical_climate         = "Tropical climate",
  large_animals            = "Presence of large animals",
  political_hierarchies    = "Political hierarchies",
  economic_complexity      = "Economic complexity",
  ln_income                = "ln income in 2000",
  ln_income_squared        = "ln income in 2000 squared"
)

add_stars <- function(p_value) {
  ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "***", ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p_value < 0.1, "*", "")))
}

format_column <- function(fit) {
  results <- fit$results
  cells <- character(0)
  for (variable in names(coefficient_labels)) {
    if (variable %in% rownames(results)) {
      estimate <- sprintf("%.3f%s", results[variable, 1], add_stars(results[variable, 4]))
      std_error <- sprintf("(%.3f)", results[variable, 2])
    } else {
      estimate <- ""
      std_error <- ""
    }
    cells <- c(cells, estimate, std_error)
  }
  model_summary <- summary(fit$model)
  c(
    cells,
    ifelse(fit$fe, "yes", "no"),
    as.character(nobs(fit$model)),
    sprintf("%.2f", model_summary$adj.r.squared),
    sprintf("%.2f", model_summary$r.squared),
    sprintf("%.2f", mean(fit$data$flfp2000))
  )
}

row_labels <- c(
  as.vector(rbind(coefficient_labels, "")),
  "Continent fixed effects", "Observations", "Adjusted R-squared",
  "R-squared", "Mean of dep. var."
)

ols_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = row_labels,
  sapply(ols_models, format_column),
  check.names = FALSE
)
colnames(ols_table) <- c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)", "(4)")
```

```{r ols-table-html}
kbl(
  ols_table, align = c("l", rep("c", 4)), row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Country-level OLS estimates of female labour force participation in 2000 (replication of Tables III and IV)"
) |>
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Dependent variable: female labour force participation in 2000" = 4), italic = TRUE) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Table III" = 2, "Table IV" = 2)) |>
  pack_rows("Historical controls:", 3, 12, italic = TRUE, bold = FALSE) |>
  pack_rows("Contemporary controls:", 13, 16, italic = TRUE, bold = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(16, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;") |>
  footnote(general = "*** p < 0.01, ** p < 0.05, * p < 0.1.", general_title = "")
```

```{r ols-table-latex}
ols_table_latex <- kbl(
  ols_table, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
  align = c("l", rep("c", 4)), row.names = FALSE
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Dependent variable: female labour force participation in 2000" = 4), italic = TRUE) |>
```

## Figure IVa - partial regression plot (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell)

```{r partial-regression-function}
partial_regression <- function(fit) {
  partial_controls <- fit$controls
  if (fit$fe) partial_controls <- c(partial_controls, "continent")

  partial_data <- fit$data
  partial_data$flfp_residual <- residuals(
    lm(reformulate(partial_controls, response = "flfp2000"), data = partial_data)
  )
  partial_data$plow_residual <- residuals(
    lm(reformulate(partial_controls, response = "plow"), data = partial_data)
  )

  residual_slope <- coef(lm(flfp_residual ~ plow_residual, data = partial_data))["plow_residual"]
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(residual_slope), unname(coef(fit$model)["plow"]))))

  list(
    data   = partial_data,
    coef   = unname(coef(fit$model)["plow"]),
    t_stat = unname(fit$results["plow", 3])
  )
}

partial_plot <- function(partial, title) {
  ggplot(partial$data, aes(x = plow_residual, y = flfp_residual)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, colour = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = isocode), size = 1.9, colour = "grey45", vjust = -0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
                colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("Slope = %.2f (robust t = %.2f), N = %d",
                         partial$coef, partial$t_stat, nrow(partial$data)),
      x        = "Traditional plough use (residual)",
      y        = "Female labour force participation 2000 (residual)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}
```

```{r figure-iva-replication, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
partial_iv_1 <- partial_regression(ols_models[["IV (1)"]])

figure_iva <- partial_plot(
  partial_iv_1,
  "Replication of Figure IVa: without continent fixed effects"
)
figure_iva

ggsave("figures/figure_iva_replication.pdf", figure_iva, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
ggsave("figures/figure_iva_replication.png", figure_iva, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

## Omitted variable bias: dropping income on the same 165 countries

```{r ovb-income}
ovb_data <- ols_models[["IV (2)"]]$data
ovb_controls <- c(historical_controls, "continent")

long_model  <- lm(reformulate(c("plow", contemporary_controls, ovb_controls), response = "flfp2000"), data = ovb_data)
short_model <- lm(reformulate(c("plow", ovb_controls), response = "flfp2000"), data = ovb_data)

delta <- coef(long_model)[contemporary_controls]
income_on_plough <- sapply(contemporary_controls, function(v)
  coef(lm(reformulate(c("plow", ovb_controls), response = v), data = ovb_data))["plow"])

income_on_plough

c(coef_without_income = unname(coef(short_model)["plow"]),
  coef_with_income    = unname(coef(long_model)["plow"]),
  bias_term           = sum(delta * income_on_plough))

turning_point <- -delta["ln_income"] / (2 * delta["ln_income_squared"])
c(turning_point_usd = unname(exp(turning_point)),
  share_below       = mean(ovb_data$ln_income < turning_point))
```

# Extension (e): Heterogeneity of the plough effect

## Setup

```{r extension-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load and prepare the data

```{r extension-data}
d <- read_dta("crosscountry_dataset.dta") |>
  zap_labels() |>
  mutate(
    continent = factor(continent),
    ln_income_c = ln_income - mean(ln_income, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Control variables

The extension builds on the Table IV specification, including
historical and contemporary income controls.

```{r extension-controls}
setFixest_fml(
  ..hist = ~ agricultural_suitability + tropical_climate +
    large_animals + political_hierarchies + economic_complexity,
  ..inc = ~ ln_income + ln_income_squared
)
```

## Plough x Communism

### Without continent fixed effects

```{r communism-no-fe}
m_comm <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * communist_dummy + ..hist + ..inc,
  data = d,
  vcov = "hetero"
)
```

### With continent fixed effects

```{r communism-fe}
m_comm_fe <- feols(
  c(flfp2000, female_ownership, women_politics) ~
    plow * communist_dummy + ..hist + ..inc | continent,
  data = d,
  vcov = "hetero"
)
```

### Marginal plough effect in communist countries

```{r communism-marginal-effects}
lincom <- function(m) {

  b <- coef(m)
  V <- vcov(m)

  a <- "plow"
  i <- "plow:communist_dummy"

  est <- b[a] + b[i]

  se <- sqrt(
    V[a, a] + V[i, i] + 2 * V[a, i]
  )

  c(
    estimate = unname(est),
    se = unname(se),
    p_value = unname(2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se))),
    CI_lower = unname(est - 1.96 * se),
    CI_upper = unname(est + 1.96 * se)
  )
}

marginal_no_fe <- as.data.frame(
  t(sapply(as.list(m_comm), lincom))
)

marginal_fe <- as.data.frame(
  t(sapply(as.list(m_comm_fe), lincom))
)

outcomes <- c(
  "FLFP 2000",
  "Female firm ownership",
  "Women in parliament"
)

marginal_no_fe$Outcome <- outcomes
marginal_no_fe$Specification <- "Without FE"

marginal_fe$Outcome <- outcomes
marginal_fe$Specification <- "With FE"

marginal_table <- bind_rows(
  marginal_no_fe,
  marginal_fe
) |>
  select(
    Outcome,
    Specification,
    estimate,
    se,
    p_value,
    CI_lower,
    CI_upper
  )

colnames(marginal_table) <- c(
  "Outcome",
  "Specification",
  "Estimate",
  "Robust SE",
  "P-value",
  "CI lower",
  "CI upper"
)
```

## Regression table functions

```{r extension-table-functions}
# Statistical significance stars

add_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    p < 0.01, "***",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.05, "**",
      ifelse(p < 0.10, "*", "")
    )
  )
}

# Extract coefficients and regression statistics

format_extension <- function(model, variables, fe) {

  results <- coeftable(model)

  cells <- unlist(lapply(variables, function(v) {

    if (v %in% rownames(results)) {

      c(
        sprintf(
          "%.3f%s",
          results[v, 1],
          add_stars(results[v, 4])
        ),
        sprintf(
          "(%.3f)",
          results[v, 2]
        )
      )

    } else {

      c("", "")

    }
  }))

  c(
    cells,
    "Yes",
    "Yes",
    ifelse(fe, "Yes", "No"),
    as.character(nobs(model)),
    sprintf("%.3f", r2(model, "ar2")),
    sprintf("%.3f", r2(model, "r2"))
  )
}

# Construct regression table

build_extension_table <- function(models, labels) {

  table_data <- data.frame(

    Variable = c(
      as.vector(rbind(unname(labels), "")),
      "Historical controls",
      "Income controls",
      "Continent fixed effects",
      "Observations",
      "Adjusted R-squared",
      "R-squared"
    ),

    sapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {

      format_extension(
        model = models[[i]],
        variables = names(labels),
        fe = i > 3
      )

    }),

    check.names = FALSE
  )

  colnames(table_data) <- c(
    "",
    "(1)", "(2)", "(3)",
    "(4)", "(5)", "(6)"
  )

  table_data
}

# Common table formatting for HTML and PDF


display_extension_table <- function(
    table_data,
    table_title,
    format = NULL,
    label = NULL
) {

  tab <- kbl(
    table_data,
    format = format,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
    row.names = FALSE,
    caption = table_title,
    label = label
  ) |>
    add_header_above(c(
      " " = 1,
      "FLFP" = 1,
      "Ownership" = 1,
      "Politics" = 1,
      "FLFP " = 1,
      "Ownership " = 1,
      "Politics " = 1
    )) |>
    add_header_above(c(
      " " = 1,
      "Without continent FE" = 3,
      "With continent FE" = 3
    ))

  is_latex <- if (is.null(format)) {
    knitr::is_latex_output()
  } else {
    format == "latex"
  }

  if (is_latex) {

    tab <- tab |>
      kable_styling(
        latex_options = "scale_down",
        full_width = FALSE,
        font_size = 9
      ) |>
      footnote(
        general = paste(
          "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors",
          "in parentheses.",
          "*** p $<$ 0.01, ** p $<$ 0.05,",
          "* p $<$ 0.10."
        ),
        general_title = "",
        escape = FALSE
      )

  } else {

    tab <- tab |>
      kable_classic(
        full_width = FALSE,
        html_font = "Times New Roman"
      ) |>
      footnote(
        general = paste(
          "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors",
          "in parentheses.",
          "*** p < 0.01, ** p < 0.05,",
          "* p < 0.10."
        ),
        general_title = ""
      )

  }

  tab
}
```

## Table B - Heterogeneity by economic development

```{r table-income-data}
inc_labels <- c(
  plow = "Traditional plough use",
  ln_income_c = "Log income (centred)",
  "plow:ln_income_c" = "Plough x Log income"
)

inc_models <- c(
  as.list(m_inc),
  as.list(m_inc_fe)
)

inc_table <- build_extension_table(
  models = inc_models,
  labels = inc_labels
)
```

```{r table-income-display, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
display_extension_table(
  table_data = inc_table,
  table_title = "Heterogeneity by economic development"
)
```

## Table C - Marginal plough effects in communist countries

```{r table-marginal-display, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
marginal_display <- kbl(
  marginal_table,
  digits = 3,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Marginal plough effects in communist countries"
)

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

  marginal_display |>
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = "scale_down",
      full_width = FALSE,
      font_size = 9
    ) |>
    footnote(
      general = paste(
        "Marginal effects are calculated as the sum",
        "of the plough and interaction coefficients.",
        "Confidence intervals use the normal approximation."
      ),
      general_title = ""
    )

} else {

  marginal_display |>
    kable_classic(
      full_width = FALSE,
      html_font = "Times New Roman"
    ) |>
    footnote(
      general = paste(
        "Marginal effects are calculated as the sum",
        "of the plough and interaction coefficients.",
        "Confidence intervals use the normal approximation."
      ),
      general_title = ""
    )

}
```

## Export regression tables

```{r extension-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Export Table A

latex_comm <- display_extension_table(
  table_data = comm_table,
  table_title = "Heterogeneity by communist history",
  format = "latex",
  label = "ext_comm"   # -> \label{tab:ext_comm}, used in report.tex
)

writeLines(
  as.character(latex_comm),
  "tables/table_extension_communism.tex"
)

# Export Table B

latex_inc <- display_extension_table(
  table_data = inc_table,
  table_title = "Heterogeneity by economic development",
  format = "latex",
  label = "ext_income" # -> \label{tab:ext_income}, used in report.tex
)

writeLines(
  as.character(latex_inc),
  "tables/table_extension_income.tex"
)

# Export Table C

latex_marginal <- kbl(
  marginal_table,
  format = "latex",
  digits = 3,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Marginal plough effects in communist countries",
  label = "ext_marginal" # -> \label{tab:ext_marginal}
) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "scale_down",
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 9
  ) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Marginal effects are calculated as the sum",
      "of the plough and interaction coefficients.",
      "Confidence intervals use the normal approximation."
    ),
    general_title = ""
  )

writeLines(
  as.character(latex_marginal),
  "tables/table_extension_marginal_effects.tex"
)

# Verify that the tables have been exported

list.files("tables")
```
